column3: 魔物兵に頭を抱えられて逃げるピサロ　（ピサロの顔立ち絵は無いので、うまく工夫して下さい）
column4: Pizarro, holding his head, flees with monster soldiers (no portrait of Pizarro's face, so please handle creatively).

column3: くそっ、宝物に目がくらみすぎたか・・いずれＪＡＰＡＮも含めて全て私が金銀を収集するのだか
column4: Damn, was I blinded too much by treasure... Eventually, including Japan, I will collect all the gold and silver.

column3: そんなに焦る必要はなかったんだ、人間共を確実に駆除してからでよかったのだ・・
column4: There was no need to rush so much; it would have been better to wipe out the humans first for sure...

column3: だが、反省した、経験を積んだ、もう同じ間違いはしない
column4: But I have reflected and gained experience; I won't make the same mistake again.

column3: ボディは失ったが、生きてさえすれば時間がかかるがボディは再生出来る。
column4: I lost my body, but as long as I live, I can regenerate it. It just takes time.

column3: ピサロ様・・あれを・・　運んでいた魔物兵が叫ぶ
column4: Lord Pizarro... that thing... The monster soldier who was carrying it shouts.

column3: 目の前をゆっくりとネプラカスが通っていく
column4: Neplacus slowly passes right in front.

column3: じっと待たないといけないのだが、待っていたら人間どもに追いつかれてしまう
column4: We must wait patiently, but if we wait, the humans will catch up with us.

column3: えーい、あんなゆっくり動いているんだ、大丈夫だ、走り抜けろー
column4: Ugh, they're moving so slowly, it'll be fine - run through!

column3: ランス達が追いついた時、その目の前でピサロは死んだ
column4: When Rance and the others caught up, Pizarro died right before their eyes.

column3: ネプラカスが立ち去るのを待って会話
column4: They wait for Neplacus to leave and then talk.

column3: 奴は倒した、後はこの事を司令部に戻った報告し、魔軍に対して本格攻勢をかけて
column4: We've defeated him. Now, we report this back to headquarters and launch a full-scale offensive against the Monster Army.

column3: 一気に勝負をつけましょう。
column4: Let's settle this once and for all.
